notes: No persons (scribe, donor, king) are named in the colophon. Bendall notes that the author of the Sragdharāstuti is Sarvajñāmitra of Kashmir from other manuscripts (Add. 1104 and 1362), but he is not mentioned in this manuscript's colophon. The date NS 904 (1784 CE) is recorded in Bendall's physical description.
